title: The Eighth Heroine
wikitext:
{{Hatnote|This article is about the [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}. For the character, see [[Eighth Heroine]].}} {{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW The Eighth Heroine.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Bozai]] |location= Gerudo Desert |prereq= [[Gerudo Outfit]] |reward= {{Icon List|BotW| * Sand Boots }} |previous= |next= {{Color BotW|Side Quest|[[The Forgotten Sword]]}} }} {{Term/Store|The Eighth Heroine||Series, BotW}} is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|The Eighth Heroine}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Gerudo Desert}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== [[Link]] can begin this [[Side Quest]] by speaking to [[Bozai]] while wearing the [[Gerudo Outfit]]. Bozai can be found sometimes running around the [[Gerudo Desert]] in front of [[Gerudo Town]]. With the Gerudo Outfit on, Bozai will think Link is a woman and become interested in him. Bozai will introduce himself to Link, making note that he is single and loves jogging on sand.{{Cite|So yeah, hey, the name's Bozai. I'm 35, single, and I LOVE jogging. Especially on sand.|Bozai|BotW}} He claims that people say he is tenacious,{{Cite|Yeah, everyone says I'm tenacious as a tick! And I think some of them meant it in a nice way, too!|Bozai|BotW}} and so he asks Link if he wants to spend some time with him.{{Cite|S-so...you out here on your own? Pretty rough and tumble place... Wanna hang out with me awhile?|Bozai|BotW}} However, instead of answering, Link notices how well he is running on the sand, which Bozai attributes to his [[Sand Boots]].{{Cite|Nice sand-jogging!] Ah... You noticed these old things? Yeah, they're my {{Color BotW|Blue|sand boots}}. They allow me to traverse the desert without being slowed down at all, so jogging is a breeze.|Bozai|BotW}} He once again tries to coerce Link into spending some time alone with him.{{Cite|If you'd like to check themout, we could grab a quiet corner and...|Bozai|BotW}} but he is thrown off by him asking for the Sand Boots.{{Cite|[Gimme those boots.] Huh?|Bozai|BotW}} Though he is initially hesitant due to their rarity,{{Cite|Oh... Well... Here's the thing. These {{Color BotW|Blue|sand boots}} are super rare, and I'd happily give them to you, but...|Bozai|BotW}} he changes his mind when he realizes he could use this to woo Link.{{Cite|... {{Small|...Wait. This is a golden chance to woo...}}|Bozai|BotW}} Bozai agrees to give the Sand Boots to Link in exchange for a favor.{{Cite|I mean, sure! I'd LOVE to give them to you, you hungry little boot monster! But first, a favor.|Bozai|BotW}} He then asks Link if he has ever heard of the [[Eighth Heroine]].{{Cite|Ever heard the legend of the {{Color BotW|Red|eighth heroine}}?|Bozai|BotW}} He explains that while everyone has heard of the [[Seven Heroines]], there is also a legend of an Eighth Heroine in the northern [[Gerudo Highlands]] that has been wiped from history.{{Cite|Everyone's heard the legend in the Gerudo region about the seven heroines, but...some tell of an {{Color BotW|Red|eighth heroine}}... Wiped clean from history, and no one knows why or how... A phantom heroine known to all but seen by none... I've been taken with the legend since I was a child.|Bozai|BotW}}{{Cite|*ahem!* According to those who idolize the {{Color BotW|Red|eighth heroine}}, she is enshrined somewhere in the {{Color BotW|Blue|Gerudo Highlands}}.|Bozai|BotW}} Bozai promises to give Link his Sand Boots if he shows him a [[Picture]] of the Eighth Heroine.{{Cite|Find her! Show me the {{Color BotW|Red|eighth heroine}}, and I'll give you these {{Color BotW|Blue|sand boots}}. What do you say?|Bozai|BotW}}{{Cite|Anyway, draw a picture or something if you find her! And then show me!|Bozai|BotW}} Bozai also suggests that there might be someone in Gerudo Town who knows more about the legend.{{Cite|Who knows, there might be someone in {{Color BotW|Blue|Gerudo Town}} who knows more about the legend of the seven heroines.|Bozai|BotW}} Before he finishes speaking, Bozai lends Link his pair of [[Snow Boots]] for faster traversal through the Gerudo Highlands.{{Cite|Oh, and here... If you'd like, you can use these. I'm sure they'll come in handy. Besides, you seem really into boots.|Bozai|BotW}} Once this is done, the Side Quest begins. If Link goes into the [[Royal Palace]] of Gerudo Town and feeds a piece of [[Fruit]] to [[Riju]]'s [[Sand Seal]], [[Patricia]], Link may receive additional information about the Eighth Heroine. [[Padda]] interprets Patricia's words, saying that [[Risoka Snowfield]] rests upon the Eighth Heroine's shoulders.{{Cite|"{{Color BotW|Blue|Risoka Snowfield}} rests upon the shoulders of the eighth heroine..." A rare, pun-free prophecy...|Padda|BotW}} Risoka Snowfield is located in the northwest section of the Gerudo Highlands. On the northern edge of the Snowfield, Link will find the [[Statue of the Eighth Heroine]]. After taking a Picture of the Statue's torso with his [[Sheikah Slate]], Link returns to Bozai to show him the picture. Bozai is glad to see Link is safe after starting to worry he would never return.{{Cite|Oh! Oh, thank goodness! You made it back safely! You were gone for so long, I started to fear the worst...|Bozai|BotW}} He admits that the Eighth Heroine does not exist and only used it as an excuse to get close to Link.{{Cite|I have to come clean. The {{Color BotW|Blue|eighth heroine}} is just an urban legend—it doesn't actually exist... I... Well, I just wanted an excuse to get close to you, y'know?|Bozai|BotW}} Since his excuse put Link in harm's way,{{Cite|I wanted to keep you engaged so I just thought up something impossible to hold your interest. And as a result, I put you in harm's way! I'm a cad! And I've been so, so worried...|Bozai|BotW}} Bozai vows not to put him in danger anymore and to be his protector.{{Cite|I won't put you in danger anymore! From now on, I'll be your protect—|Bozai|BotW}} When Link interrupts to say that he found the Statue, Bozai will think that Link is merely trying to console him.{{Cite|[Found it.] Are you trying to console me because I've been so heartsick over this?|Bozai|BotW}} He calls Link a kind soul, but he insists there is no need to coddle him.{{Cite|You're such a kind soul. But no need to coddle me. From now on I'll—|Bozai|BotW}} Link interrupts Bozai again to show him the Picture of the Statue, which Bozai is shocked to actually exists.{{Cite|[Look at this!] That...certainly is...the way it was rumored to look... That— {{Big|THAT'S AMAZING!}} I thought it was just an old wives' tale! The {{Color BotW|Blue|eighth heroine}} actually exists?!|Bozai|BotW}} He promises to keep it a secret as a way for the two of them to bond.{{Cite|...But I won't tell anyone... Yeah, that way, it'll just be our little secret, right? Sort of a bonding thing.|Bozai|BotW}} Bozai begins to ask Link for romantic involvement,{{Cite|And yeah, i-if it's OK, I'd like to take this opportunity to ask you—|Bozai|BotW}} before Link interrupts him, asking for the Sand Boots he was promised.{{Cite|[Sand boots, please!] Oh... Oh, OK...|Bozai|BotW}} Bozai takes the Sand Boots off and gives them to Link, telling him to treat them tenderly.{{Cite|Just a second. I'll take them off... Treat them as tenderly as you would me.|Bozai|BotW}} Bozai then requests his Snow Boots back, which Link obliges.{{Cite|*ahem* And now, could you be a lamb and return my {{Color BotW|Blue|snow boots}}? Otherwise ol' Bozai's going to be barefoot!|Bozai|BotW}} Before leaving, Bozai invites Link to join him later at the nearby tent.{{Cite|I think I'll just park myself under the tent in front of Gerudo Town and take five. Care to join me later?|Bozai|BotW}} Link says bye without answering the question,{{Cite|[Good-bye.] Huh? Aw... Good... Good-bye.|Bozai|BotW}} and the Side Quest is completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | There's a legend about seven heroines in the Gerudo region, but it turns out that an {{Color BotW|Red|eighth heroine}} existed, and she is worshiped to this day by her faithful in the {{Color BotW|Red|Gerudo Highlands}}. Show a picture of the {{Color BotW|Red|eighth statue's torso}} to Bozai to get the sand boots. You've heard that there's someone well acquainted with the seven heroines' legend in Gerudo Town. |- | Complete | The eighth heroine is still worshiped by her faithful in the Gerudo Highlands. You captured her in a picture and received the sand boots from Bozai as promised. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bozai * Eighth Heroine * Gerudo Desert * Statue of the Eighth Heroine }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
